Shows whether this phone is idle, ringing or in a call, after you allow it. Only that coarse state is read: no phone numbers, call log or contacts are requested, shown or stored, so an incoming call is just \"Ringing\". This preview stays on the phone; sharing call status with a computer is a separate switch in Setup > Answer calls.

Call audio is carried by your phone\'s regular Bluetooth hands-free (HFP) link to the computer, managed by Android. This app cannot capture or inject cellular call audio and does not try to. To use the phone as a headset for the computer, pair the two in Bluetooth settings.

Checks a draft against the shared message rules in the native core; nothing is sent from this box. Reading and sending texts for a paired computer is optional and set up in Setup > Share with computer. It needs the SMS permissions, which Android restricts: stores generally allow them only for the default SMS app, and sideloaded installs on Android 13+ may need \"Allow restricted settings\". A denial at the runtime prompt is final until you change it in app settings. Nothing is ever sent automatically.
Subscription id must be a whole number.

The network is used to talk to the computers you paired (encrypted, certificate-pinned) and by update checks, which only read GitHub\'s public release list when the app opens (at most every 12 hours, can be switched off) or when you tap Check for updates. A small background service keeps the phone reachable only while \"Stay connected\" is on, and only for computers you paired. Updates are installed only after a SHA-256 check and your confirmation in Android\'s installer. The app never asks for accessibility, root or ADB access. Contacts, calendar, clipboard and message text are shared only with a paired computer you allowed, are not logged or saved here, and previews are cleared when you leave the app.

Your phone and your computer talk over an encrypted link on your own network (TCP + TLS with certificate pinning). Pairing needs your approval of an exact code and certificate. Once paired you can share the clipboard, send files and answer calls, and, if you switch them on, share texts, contacts and calendar. The link starts when you tap Start and stops when you leave the app.
